title: Joomla untick: an article a kept page still shows keeps an entry the router finds, so its links stop answering 404
steps: S1: No stand and no site. From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/joomla-kept-article-routes.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/joomla-unticked-articles.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs

S2: joomla-kept-article-routes reads the JA Essence j6 1.0.3 presentation lock (packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts/ja-essence/j6/1.0.3), unticks entries 142 (Category Style 1, Health catid 9) and 139 (Video), and checks every article that stays published against a model of Joomla's menu lookup (article entry, else an entry of its category or a category above it) after the tidy-up's writes.
S3: brief-joomla runs the whole Joomla brief engine against a fake site with a featured front page and an unticked category list, and reads the content.batch the tidy-up sends.
S4: Read the node:test summary lines (pass / fail counts) and every failing test name.
expect: Essence 1.0.3 with 142 and 139 unticked: articles 21, 22, 24, 25, 26 are unpublished; articles 15, 18, 19, 20 (featured on the front page) are named in routes; no published article is left without an entry the router finds.

The route writes are a menutype tracy-article-routes (only when no entry carries it yet) and one menuItem per article: id 0, view=article link, parent_id 1, published 1, type component, params menu_show 0, alias = the article alias (with the article id appended when a top-level entry holds it).
Engine run: the menutype and menuItem creates ride in the same single content.batch as the unpublished menu entry and articles; times.articlesRouted = 1.

selectors.seam: articlesGoing(...).routes and routeSteps({ rows, articles }) in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/joomla-article-routes.js

evidence: Step 5.5 of the Template Customization Question Readiness spec on dev (cowork.tracy.site), 10/10/2026: g55-ess-j-full (JA Essence j6 1.0.3, Category Style 1 and Detail > Video unticked) linked /index.php/pages/j-content/category-blog/capturing-essence-expressive-line-art-techniques (404) from the kept Category Blog page; the same article answered 200 at /index.php?view=article&id=20; g55-ess-j-blank (nothing unticked) linked it at /index.php/category/category-style-1/... (200).
fence: articlesGoing names kept articles with no route left (joomla-articles.js); the Joomla tidy-up writes routeSteps in its transaction (joomla.js). Pure function tests over a real release lock and a fake door: no live Joomla router ran.
